author: Kevin Kelly
short: Discord event logging with configurable routing.
description: Log messages, reactions, server/thread changes, members/presence, voice activity, scheduled events, and bot commands with configurable switches and channel routing. Use [p]log or /log settings, plus direct logstatus/logchannel/lograte controls.
install_msg: Load with [p]load logplus, then use [p]log setchannel #channel. See the cog README for permissions, command names, and current limitations. Enable slash commands as the bot owner with [p]slash enablecog logplus, then [p]slash sync.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild event settings, log destination channel IDs, routing overrides, exemption channel IDs, and style/rate preferences in Red Config. It does not persist message contents in Config. Discord log messages can contain user names and IDs, message contents, invite codes, and event details. These posted logs remain in Discord until removed there.
